changes: One-morning story becomes four explicit days.
Family joy remains on day1; later tiredness and annoyance are not overwritten by smiles.
Temporary removable channel makes a multi-day nuisance physically plausible.
Flowers move to day2 and obstruct the channel; the talking toy appears unexpectedly on day3.
Canonical duck changes from carved wood to ordinary soft yellow plastic.
Inverse solution is seeded by a short reverse arc and confirmed by a controlled test.
Existing R3 images are composition candidates only; no artwork is copied or selected.
